[d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1] decision (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  Gate `report_against` and its tests on `gemini` or `anthropic` features
  The function is only reached from the feature-gated `gemini` and `anthropic` mappers, so builds without those features had an unused function and CI's `-D warnings` failed.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-11] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update ROAD_TO_1.0.md to mark steps 1 and 2 done, step 3 deferred, and correct the assumption that python/, …
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-11-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-12] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update format spec §8.5 to record the version-trap defect as fixed in 0.14.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-13] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update format spec §8.6 to say smysl/1.0 is not a break and means the format is settled rather than changed.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-13-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-14] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Defer flipping the writer default to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 is published.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-14-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-15] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Do not add version lists to python/, nodejs/, go/ implementations.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-15-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-4] decision (cited, source crates/smysl-core/src/surface/parse.rs@69ea5c05d859)
  Implement a custom Default for ParseOutcome that sets format_version to FORMAT_VERSION_DEFAULT.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-4-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-6] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Pass the parsed format_version from ParseOutcome to WriteContext in `smysl fmt`.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-6-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-1] decision (cited, source fuzz/fuzz_targets/pack_exact.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Build Constraints via default and field assignment instead of struct literal
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-1-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-10] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Assert on transcript count rather than just MISMATCHED presence in doc output test
  The first version asserted only that MISMATCHED appeared, which ran 0 transcripts satisfied; the count assertion ensures a gate that cannot confuse nothing wrong with nothing checked.
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-10-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-11] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Compile out the doc output test outside the default-ish feature set
  The script compares against a default-features build; running under other features caused false drift, and a compiled-out test is better than a runtime skip.
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-11-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-2] decision (cited, source fuzz/fuzz_targets/pack_exact.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Remove unused BTreeSet import from pack_exact.rs
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-2-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-3] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Add a fuzz-build Makefile target to compile fuzz targets without running them
  The fuzz workspace is separate and was never compiled by root workspace checks; compiling is cheap and catches breakages.

[d/g87345653cdf3-4] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Make `make ci` depend on fuzz-build
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-4-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-5] decision (cited, source Makefile@87345653cdf3)
  Do not pipe fuzz-build's cargo check through tail
  A pipeline's exit status is the last command's, so piping through tail would print errors but return 0; the gate must return non-zero on failure.

[d/g87345653cdf3-6] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Do not run fuzzers as part of make ci; only compile them
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-6-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-7] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Make verify-doc-output.py binary path overridable via SMYSL_BIN
  This lets the new cargo test pass the binary cargo built for it, so mutation testing exercises the mutated binary rather than a stale one.
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-7-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-8] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Fix path extraction in verify-doc-output.py to skip token 0
  Token 0 is the binary name, not a manual input; if the binary path is absolute, the absolute-path rule would otherwise skip all commands.
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-8-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-9] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Add tests/doc_output.rs so cargo test runs the doc output replay
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-9-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-2] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Remove `IMPROVEMENT_PASSES` constant and `PackRequest::improvement_passes` field.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-2-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-3] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Decline to keep the search that measured the pass.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-3-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-4] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Decline to update the golden file.

[d/ga18e230ae345-5] decision (cited, source crates/smysl-pack/src/solve.rs@a18e230ae345)
  Add a comment explaining the removal in place of the loop.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-5-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-6] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@a18e230ae345)
  Document the removal in the changelog.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-6-1

[e/g69ea5c05d859-16-1] evidence (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Check: make semver is 12/12 clean

[e/g69ea5c05d859-9-1] evidence (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Check: make ci green

[p/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-1] constraint (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  `report_against` is only reached from the `gemini` and `anthropic` mappers, both feature-gated
  -> conditions d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1

[p/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1-2] constraint (cited, source git:0bc1aeb96d6b6bd4140a24886064f1d60a42829e)
  CI sets `-D warnings`, which refuses an unused function
  -> conditions d/g0bc1aeb96d6b-1

[p/g87345653cdf3-10-1] constraint (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  The script prints a summary line with a parseable ran count.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-10

[p/g87345653cdf3-11-1] constraint (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  The script expects default-features build output; other features cause drift.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-11

[p/g87345653cdf3-3-1] constraint (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  The fuzz directory is a separate workspace not compiled by root workspace checks.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-3

[p/g87345653cdf3-4-1] constraint (cited, source Makefile@87345653cdf3)
  The fuzz-build target compiles fuzz targets and reports failure.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-4

[p/g87345653cdf3-4-2] constraint (cited, source Makefile@87345653cdf3)
  make ci is the target that CI runs locally and remotely.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-4

[p/g87345653cdf3-5-1] constraint (cited, source Makefile@87345653cdf3)
  Shell pipeline exit status is the last command's, so tail masks failure.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-5

[p/g87345653cdf3-7-1] constraint (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  cargo sets CARGO_BIN_EXE_smysl to the binary built for the integration test.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-7

[p/g87345653cdf3-8-1] constraint (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Token 0 is the binary path, and the absolute-path rule skips tokens containing '/'.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-8

[p/g87345653cdf3-8-2] constraint (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  SMYSL_BIN may be absolute because CARGO_BIN_EXE_smysl always is.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-8

[q/g69ea5c05d859-11-1] claim (inferred)
  ROAD_TO_1.0 updated: steps 1-2 done, step 3 deferred; python/nodejs/go have no version lists.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1] claim (inferred)
  Format spec §8.5 records version-trap defect fixed in 0.14.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-13-1] claim (inferred)
  Format spec §8.6 says smysl/1.0 is not a break; format settled rather than changed.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-14-1] claim (inferred)
  Writer default deferred to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 published; avoids other implementations rejecting output.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-15-1] claim (inferred)
  No version lists added to python/nodejs/go; they read CBOR only and never see @doc header.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-4-1] claim (inferred)
  Default ParseOutcome sets format_version to FORMAT_VERSION_DEFAULT, avoiding empty @doc header on CBOR path.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-6-1] claim (inferred)
  `smysl fmt` passes parsed format_version to WriteContext, preserving document self-description.

[q/g87345653cdf3-1-1] claim (inferred)
  Constraints built via default and field assignment compiles despite non_exhaustive; future fields stay …

[q/g87345653cdf3-10-1] claim (inferred)
  Count assertion prevents gate from confusing nothing wrong with nothing checked.

[q/g87345653cdf3-11-1] claim (inferred)
  Compile out doc output test outside default feature set to avoid false drift.

[q/g87345653cdf3-2-1] claim (inferred)
  Remove unused BTreeSet import after replacing struct literal with default construction.

[q/g87345653cdf3-4-1] claim (inferred)
  make ci depends on fuzz-build, so CI gates on fuzz compilation.

[q/g87345653cdf3-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Only compile fuzzers in CI; running remains separate due to nightly and time.

[q/g87345653cdf3-7-1] claim (inferred)
  SMYSL_BIN override lets cargo test use freshly built binary, so mutation tests exercise mutated code.

[q/g87345653cdf3-8-1] claim (inferred)
  Skip token 0 in path extraction to avoid absolute binary path skipping every command.

[q/g87345653cdf3-9-1] claim (inferred)
  Adding tests/doc_output.rs exposes replay to cargo test and coverage tools.

[q/ga18e230ae345-2-1] claim (inferred)
  IMPROVEMENT_PASSES constant and PackRequest::improvement_passes field removed from the public API.

[q/ga18e230ae345-3-1] claim (inferred)
  The search test is removed; keeping it would compare two identical configurations.

[q/ga18e230ae345-5-1] claim (inferred)
  A comment in solve.rs documents the removal rationale and measurements.

[q/ga18e230ae345-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Changelog records the removal under Unreleased 0.8.0.

[r/g87345653cdf3-11-1] claim (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Rejected: Skip the doc output test at runtime outside default feature set
  Running under other features caused false drift; a compiled-out test is better than a silently passing skip.
  -> contrasts d/g87345653cdf3-11
